Explicit malformed SQLite database triggers old warning then deletes result/checkpoint files instead of refusing. No repaired/new DB may appear.

docs.conclusion: Contract matches scoped behavior: intentional no-cfg/low-level API refusal, no implicit DB bootstrap, no symlink/cross-device/overwrite fallback, dry-run planned counts, same-filesystem archive moved_bytes rather than freed_bytes, partial reclamation and no automatic recovery.
